helpText.message:
This extension saves manual work by quickly adding Megascans assets to your Library.

Before your first run, confirm that you are signed in. Two actions are available after signing in:
1. Claim all: scan the catalog and add assets to your Library as scanning progresses.
2. Scan catalog only: scan the catalog without adding assets to your Library.

Set the delay between batches (suggested: 300 ms or more) and the number of items per batch (suggested: 3–10). Larger batches should use longer delays. Once every task in a batch finishes, the extension waits for the configured delay before starting the next batch.

Suggested settings (items per batch: delay between batches):
3–5 items: 300 ms
6–10 items: 500–800 ms

These are starting points, not a guarantee against server rate limits. If a limit is triggered, the extension automatically increases the batch delay and updates the input and status notice. You can also pause, increase the delay manually, and resume.

This extension only adds free assets to your Library; it does not download model files.

If you encounter a problem, export the LOG and email it to thstudio3419@pm.me.
